import os,json,copy,sys
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from dojo.skills import library as L
from dojo.skills import grasps as G
from dojo.skills.skills import Skills
from dojo.skills.geometry import inv_T,T_from
from dojo.skills.motion import MoveResult,Motion
from dojo.simlab import paths
from dojo.simlab.runner import RoboDojoRunner
from dojo.skills.world import AssetDB
from dojo.skills.g3 import run_episode
TASK=sys.argv[1]; SEED=int(sys.argv[2]); MODES=sys.argv[3:]
root=paths.DATA/'round2';root.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
lay=json.loads((paths.LAYOUTS/TASK/f'{SEED}.settled.json').read_text())
lay["_simlab"]["seed"]=SEED
assets=AssetDB(paths.OBJECTS)
run=RoboDojoRunner(TASK,num_envs=1,workdir=str(root/f'work-{TASK}-{SEED}'),physics_only=True,need_planner=False)
original_motion=Motion.to_pose
original_run=Skills.run_transfer
original=Skills.plan_transfer

def band(o,arm):
 v=o.asset.mesh[0];out=[]
 for x in [0.,-.02,.02]:
  p=v[(abs(v[:,0]-x)<.012)&(v[:,2]>.075)]
  if len(p)<5:continue
  lo,hi=p.min(0),p.max(0)
  for ax in [2,1]:
   closing=o.R[:,ax]
   approach=o.R[:,1 if ax==2 else 2]
   if approach[2]>0:approach=-approach
   centre=(hi+lo)*.5;centre[0]=x
   out.append(G.Grasp('bridge',T_from(o.R@centre+o.pos,G._frame(approach,closing)),float(hi[ax]-lo[ax]),note=f'bridge {x} axis{ax}'))
 return out
for mode in MODES:
 blocked=[]
 def staged(self,arm,q0,T_goal,step_rad=.06,name="move",gripper=1.,ignore=(),held=None,**kw):
  if mode not in ("staged", "settled", "cup", "retry", "dense") or name != "place_approach" or held is None or held.label != "headset":
   return original_motion(self,arm,q0,T_goal,step_rad,name,gripper,ignore,held,**kw)
  now=self.kin.tcp(arm,q0)@held.T_tcp_obj
  mid=T_goal@held.T_tcp_obj
  mid[:2,3]=now[:2,3]
  mid[2,3]=max(mid[2,3],now[2,3])
  T_mid=mid@inv_T(held.T_tcp_obj)
  a=original_motion(self,arm,q0,T_mid,step_rad,"clear_rotate",gripper,ignore,held,**kw)
  if not a.ok:return a
  b=self.line(arm,a.q_end,T_goal,step_rad,"upright_carry",gripper=gripper,ignore=ignore,held=held,check=True)
  return a.then(b)
 Motion.to_pose=staged
 def run_transfer(self,pp,pl,**kw):
  if mode=="settled" and pp.label=="headset":kw["tol_xy"]=.02
  grasp_obj=inv_T(pp.T_tcp_obj)
  r=original_run(self,pp,pl,**kw)
  if mode=='retry' and r.status=='loose':blocked.append(grasp_obj)
  return r
 Skills.run_transfer=run_transfer
 def transfer(self,label,targets,**kw):
  if label=='headset':
   if mode=='retry' and blocked:
    old=kw['grasps'];o=self.world.obj(label)
    kw['grasps']=lambda arm: [g for g in old(arm) if not any(np.linalg.norm((inv_T(o.T)@g.T)[:3,3]-b[:3,3])<.025 and abs((inv_T(o.T)@g.T)[:3,1]@b[:3,1])>.8 for b in blocked)]
   if mode=='dense':
    o=self.world.obj(label)
    kw['grasps']=lambda arm: [g for g in G.box_grasps(o,self.kin,arm)+G.slice_grasps(o,self.kin,arm)+G.antipodal_grasps(o,self.kin,arm,n_samples=400,n_approach=13) if g.width>=.035]
    kw['max_full']=24
   if mode=='cup':
    o=self.world.obj(label)
    kw['pair_rank']=lambda g,*a: 0. if (inv_T(o.T)@g.T)[2,3] < o.asset.bbox_min[2]+.05 else 50.
   if mode.startswith('high') or mode.startswith('band'):
    kw['place_kw']=dict(kw.get('place_kw') or {},pre_h=.20 if mode=='high20' else .12)
    kw['lift_to_pre']=True
   if mode.startswith('band'):
    kw['grasps']=lambda arm:band(self.world.obj(label),arm)
    kw['pick_kw']={'squeeze':8};kw['max_full']=24
  result=original(self,label,targets,**kw)
  if not isinstance(result,tuple):print("PLAN_FAIL",mode,result.note,flush=True)
  return result
 Skills.plan_transfer=transfer
 out=root/f'{TASK}-{SEED}-{mode}';out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
 r=run_episode(run,TASK,lay,assets,out,trace=True,skill_attrs={'hang_cradle':'straddle','headset_seat':'on'})
 (out/'row.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2))
 print('PROBE',mode,json.dumps(r),flush=True)
Skills.plan_transfer=original
run.close()

import json,hashlib,subprocess,sys,os
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.home()/'dojo-data/laptop';task=sys.argv[1];lock=sys.argv[2]
d=root/'simlab/layouts'/task
idx=json.loads((d/'settled_index.json').read_text())
ids=[i for i in range(100050,100065) if idx.get(str(i),{}).get('status')=='ok'][:10]
assert len(ids)==10,(task,ids)
manifest=[{'id':i,'sha256':hashlib.sha256((d/f'{i}.settled.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()} for i in ids]
(root/f'round2b-manifest-{task}.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2))
for group,arm in [(0,'off'),(1,'on'),(0,'on'),(1,'off')]:
 selected=ids[group::2];name=f'r2b-panel-{task}-{arm}-{group}'
 cmd=['bash',str(root/'job.sh'),name,'-m','dojo.skills.g3','run','--task',task,'--seeds',','.join(map(str,selected)),
      '--skill-attr','hang_cradle=straddle','--skill-attr',f'headset_seat={arm}',
      '--skill-attr',f'headset_carry={"staged" if arm=="on" else "legacy"}',
      '--skill-attr',f'headset_grasp={"dense" if arm=="on" else "legacy"}',
      '--trace','--out',str(root/name)]
 with (root/'logs'/f'{name}.log').open('w') as f:r=subprocess.run(cmd,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,env=dict(os.environ,LAPTOP_LOCK=lock))
 with (root/f'round2b-progress-{task}.jsonl').open('a') as f:f.write(json.dumps({'name':name,'rc':r.returncode})+'\n')
 if r.returncode:raise SystemExit(r.returncode)
(root/f'round2b-done-{task}').write_text('complete\n')

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
name="$1"; shift
export RD_HOME="$HOME/dojo-robodojo" DOJO_DATA="$HOME/dojo-data/laptop"
export DOJO_CATALOG="$HOME/dojo-data/skills4/catalog:$HOME/dojo-data/skills3/catalog:$HOME/dojo-perception-data/catalog"
export SIMLAB_GPU=0 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1
cd "$HOME/controlr-laptop"
exec 9>>"$HOME/${LAPTOP_LOCK:-dojo-gpu-light7.lock}"
flock -w 14400 9
source scripts/dojo/disk_guard.sh
disk_guard laptop
who > "$DOJO_DATA/logs/$name.admission"
nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps=pid,process_name,used_memory --format=csv >> "$DOJO_DATA/logs/$name.admission"
used=$(nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used --format=csv,noheader,nounits)
printf 'time=%s used_MiB=%s\n' "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" "$used" >> "$DOJO_DATA/logs/$name.admission"
[[ "$used" -le 24576 ]] || exit 75
printf 'pid=%s stream=LAPTOP start=%s\n' "$$" "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" > "$HOME/${LAPTOP_LOCK:-dojo-gpu-light7.lock}"
exec timeout -k 60 1800 systemd-run --user --scope -q -p MemoryMax=8G -p CPUQuota=600% scripts/simlab/rdpy.sh -u "$@"
